'''July 2001 Durham tournament''' was a Star Wars CCG local (unsanctioned sealed) held at Sports Cards Unlimited, Durham, NC on 15 July 2001. [[Edwin Harris]] won it. It is known from Edwin Harris's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d2637">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-07-15-durham-nc-7-15d2637/ durham-nc-7-15], DeckTech (Edwin "Edwin" Harris, 15 July 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-07-15-durham-nc-7-15d2637/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 15 July 2001
* '''Site:''' Sports Cards Unlimited, Durham, NC
* '''Players:''' 5
* '''Winner:''' [[Edwin Harris]]
